_README: CANONICAL measured figures. Every gas or ratio claim in prose (CLAUDE.md,
README.md, docs/, NatSpec, commit messages) must agree with this file, and
this file is enforced by Measurements.test.js, which RE-MEASURES each entry
rather than trusting it.
Why this exists: three strategic conclusions in this project were reversed
because a number was wrong, and each reversal was then APPENDED next to the
wrong claim instead of replacing it. A later reader — including a later
session — met the stale claim first and re-derived from it. The 'skip t=16'
decision was made from a >100M figure that was already known to be an
artefact. Prose cannot be kept in sync by discipline alone; this file can be
kept in sync by CI.
HOW TO MEASURE (the three mistakes that produced the reversals):
1. A gasLimit above 2^24 is REJECTED BEFORE EXECUTION (EIP-7825). A
rejection is not an out-of-gas. Always confirm the call actually ran.
2. estimateGas over-provisions nested calls by ~3x (63/64 rule per frame).
Measure gasUsed of a SENT transaction; for a view function, binary
search the smallest passing gasLimit.
3. In a RATIO, shared overhead must cancel. Two single external calls both
carry the 21,000 transaction base, which inflates the smaller one and
understates the ratio. Measure marginally: gas(n+1) - gas(n).
Tolerance is 3%: compiler and fixture regeneration move these slightly, a
real regression moves them much more.
